class.name: CgameBitReader

method.name: align_to_byte
method.description: Skips to the next byte boundary.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a reader positioned at the start of [param bytes].

method.name: get_bit_position
method.description: Returns the index of the next bit to be read.

method.name: get_bits_remaining
method.description: Returns the number of unread bits, including padding bits of the last byte.

method.name: is_overflowed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any read ran past the end of the data since the bytes were set.

method.name: read_angle
method.description: Reads an angle in [code][0, TAU)[/code] written by [method CgameBitWriter.write_angle].

method.name: read_bits
method.description: Reads [param bits] bits (0 to 64) as an unsigned value. With 64 bits the result is the raw two's complement integer.

method.name: read_bytes
method.description: Reads [param count] bytes. Stops early on overflow.

method.name: read_float
method.description: Reads a value quantized by [method CgameBitWriter.write_float].

method.name: read_quaternion
method.description: Reads a "smallest three" quaternion. The result is normalized and has a maximum component error of about half a quantum of the [code]±1/√2[/code] range.

method.name: read_string
method.description: Reads a string written by [method CgameBitWriter.write_string].

method.name: read_varint
method.description: Reads an unsigned varint of at most ten groups.

method.name: set_bit_position
method.description: Moves the read cursor to [param position], clamped to the data size.

method.name: set_bytes
method.description: Replaces the data and resets the cursor and the overflow flag.

members.member: The data being read. Setting it rewinds the reader.
